title: Hourly electric-grid balance and forecasts
question: How do demand ramps relate to forecast error and balancing response across grid areas?
measurement_dates: 2025-01-01 through 2025-06-30 hourly reporting window, with source local/UTC endpoint fields.
variables_and_units: Variables and units are preserved in native column headers, instrument metadata and source dictionaries; see evidence anchors below.
independent_units: Balancing authority and full time blocks.
validation_design: Balancing authority and full time blocks. Verify identifiers before allocating groups; the partition is not executed or frozen by this acquisition.
author_preprocessing: Published balancing-authority operational products include author/agency imputations and adjustments. All variants are preserved; no additional imputation or correction was performed.
prior_analysis_and_limits: EIA grid accounting is already documented. Demand-generation-interchange equalities are accounting identities, not discoveries. Timestamp conventions, reporting gaps and fuel-category revisions may introduce apparent relationships. EIA-930 January–June 2025 reported grid operations; accounting balances and revised estimates are not independent physical discoveries.
missingness: Native blanks, sentinels, absent records and source quality flags are preserved. No imputation performed by the curator. Exact missingness semantics come from source dictionaries/headers; no universal missing-value rule is imposed.
calibration: Use the retained source calibration files/standards and instrument metadata where provided. Absence of an explicit calibration record is not replaced by an assumed calibration.
